facts.fact: Home Affairs Minister Kazembe told the National Assembly that the crime management system built by the Harare Institute of Technology is running as a proof of concept at Warren Park Police Station and 'a couple of other' stations, with wider deployment to follow once it is seen to work; no sitting date is given, so dated by the Herald's publication.
facts.system: ZRP Integrated Information System (crime management subsystem)

facts.fact: The Herald describes the system piloted at Warren Park and other stations as a digital crime reporting system, a crime management subsystem of the ZRP Integrated Information System; it does not name the occurrence book or the docket, and the date is the publication date.
facts.system: ZRP Integrated Information System (crime management subsystem)

facts.fact: The minister said crime management has been piloted and is being tested at Warren Park and a couple of other stations, reported 8 October 2026; the pilot's start date is not given, so dated by publication.

facts.fact: The minister said the police system is the ZRP Integrated Information System, run as a Ministry of Home Affairs programme, with its crime management subsystem developed by the state Harare Institute of Technology; dated by publication.

facts.fact: The minister said the Ministry of Home Affairs is pursuing an integrated ICT strategy from which stem a system for immigration, one for the civil registry and one for the police, the ZRP Integrated Information System; dated by publication.
